commercialPurpose: Support long-form detail pages where the main story changes media type while trust and discovery utilities remain stable.
purposeLayer: The layout lets buyers package image, slider, video, quote, audio, or link posts as reusable editorial story states.
anatomyLayer: Single media-led article, post title, body copy, share/comment row, and persistent sidebar with author, newsletter, social, tags, related posts, and ad modules.
hierarchyLayer: Media object first, story title/body second, sidebar trust/discovery third.
gridRhythmLayer: Detail-page two-column grid with stable sidebar and variable first media module.
densityLimitLayer: Use one primary media object, one body column, 3-7 sidebar widgets, and 0-1 related content cluster.
originalityLayer: Learn the media-state system and persistent context rail; do not copy exact post assets or widget order.
usageRuleLayer: Use for article details, portfolio stories, case-study pages, resource details, and CMS state libraries.
layoutGesture: media-led story page with stable sidebar context
sectionSilhouette: single long article body beside narrow utility rail
compositionTension: large changing media object anchored by consistent side proof modules
focalPath: media module to title to body copy to sidebar related content
negativeSpaceShape: long white reading corridor with compact right rail
depthLayering: flat article surface with embedded media player or gallery controls
moduleScaleVariation: one dominant media module and many small utility widgets
breakoutBehavior: media changes format while grid frame remains stable
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact media screenshots, audio/player styling, sidebar ad, or lifestyle imagery.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint learning is visually inspected but not yet promoted to stable PASS; keep as incoming review vocabulary.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
